scope: synthetic-only localization repair and fixed fresh-sequence real short pilot; not full benchmark
initialization: same original random seed0 lineage through each v1 synthetic-only arm; confidence channel reset to zero in both; frozen learned backbones retained
checkpoint_selection: fixed final classifier optimization solution; unchanged synthetic gate blocks all real scoring on failure
input: full-frame event-derived ON/OFF/total log counts; no RGB, GT mask/crop/box/pose at inference
real_window: each MAT raw event window only, approximately10ms; no union of adjacent windows
real_coordinates: raw events undistorted with official K and distortion, then binned; PnP uses ideal K
keypoints: original CAD AABB centroid then eight lexicographic min/max corners; not legacy stored UV
pnp: fixed OpenCV SOLVEPNP_EPNP, eight corners, no GT choice of cells/solutions
primary_metric: ADD-S mean and success at0.1*exact mesh diameter; all200 denominator, PnP failures count as unsuccessful
metric_scope: derived corrected geometry pilot; not a claimed reproduction of official full E-POSE leaderboard protocol
deadline_policy: training1800s; real_eval600s; synthetic gate blocks scoring on failure
training: same SingleShotPose architecture; freeze backbone and coordinates after v4; fit confidence channel as explicit single-object centroid-grid classifier
augmentation: 8 fixed scale/translation views per16 train windows=128; same affine matrices across arms; no GT inference crop
real_sequence_inventory_fallback: r_02_gl not present; r_05_gl chosen from inventory and all predeclared indices verified before fitting or score access
rationale: v4 original quality-confidence objective remains unstable for V2E; use a common explicit center-classification training adapter, clearly distinct from official original training; all selection uses synthetic data only
learning_rate_schedule: linear warmup first20 updates; 0.1 decay after update300
feature_normalization: mean/std from all synthetic train feature locations only; folded back into final confidence channel weights; no test fitting
decoder: raw logit argmax and stable softmax confidence; no GT cell or event-derived box
